title: a successor future handed on as a plain Future is used at the boundary
purpose: A Future<^T> crosses an argument, a field, a declared result and a typed local as Future<T> (#790).

provenance.origin: authored for #790 from the owner's decision of 2026-11-21
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.1: a Future<^T> is accepted where Future<T> is expected at an argument, a field and a declared result; a typed local keeps the obligation until it is awaited.
